summary: The agent's desk by message: a running Workshop's guide marked for a guest, and the controls whose press may cause a message found with the steps to one.

tools.name: guide
tools.summary: Mark one control of a running Workshop's desk for the weaver to see, by the address a press names; an empty control clears this session's mark.
tools.description: Asks Workshop (zengine.workshop), through the link, GuideRequested version 1: the pane as <office>/<pane>, the control by its action id (the pane draws it as the part control:<id>) or part:<name> for a subject part, and at most 60 bytes of printable ASCII shown beside the guest's own row name. Workshop judges the row's `guide` and `capture` doors first, then whether the part shows now in a settled picture; it draws one mark a session, inside the pane's body, in the guide role, and says whether its label found a free row. A control with no part is answered not shown, with the weaver's key. The weaver's own press inside the mark ends it, and so do its part leaving the picture, its pane's holder changing, a newer mark of this session and the session's end. Never on Connections, the Hotkeys pane, or a part whose press opens either. Presses nothing and changes nothing else.

inputs.name: pane
inputs.help: the pane, <office>/<pane>, as a reading names it

inputs.name: control
inputs.help: the control's action id, or part:<name> for a subject part; empty clears this session's mark

inputs.name: words
inputs.help: what the mark says beside the guest's name

inputs.name: link
inputs.help: the external host's link to the Workshop

requires: the `guide` power, a guests file of version 3: a row that may guide within its `guide` doors
zengine-guest-vocabulary booted in this Loom session, declaring GuideRequested and GuideAnswered
tools.example: loom-session run <dir> desk/guide --name guide-1 --input pane=zengine.builder-pane/builder --input control=builder.build --input words="build this one"
tools.recovery: A refusal names why: the row lacks `guide`, the pane is outside its doors, the pane is one only the weaver's hand reaches, another guest marks it, the part shows nowhere now, or the desk holds 16 marks. 'not shown' with a key names a control drawn as no part: say the key in words.

tools.name: resolve
tools.summary: The controls on a running Workshop's desk whose press may cause a message, resolved from what this row may read; marks one when exactly one is shown and usable.
tools.description: Asks, through the link, the guest door for this session's own row (GuestRowDescribed version 2: its `capture` doors), and Workshop for the keymap (KeymapShown version 4: every row in force with its address, the weaver's key and what a press may cause, and each pane's other modes), the desk (DeskRead version 3), the pane inventory and, for each pane a candidate stands in, its parts (PaneView version 7, each with whether its operation applies now). Says every control that may cause the message: its address, the part that draws it, whether it shows and is usable now, the weaver's key and where its pane is; and when none is shown and usable, the steps that would bring one, nearest first: a row in force entering the pane's other mode, and showing the pane, itself a message resolved the same way, at most 3 steps deep, never through Connections or the Hotkeys pane. When no control this row may read causes it: the panes outside its read, or, for a row that reads every pane, the case for a tool as four claims, filed nowhere. With `mark` on, marks the one control shown and usable, else the nearest step's one, through GuideRequested. Presses nothing.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.help: the message the weaver should cause, by name

inputs.name: subject
inputs.help: what it is about, <office>/<pane>, for a message about a subject

inputs.name: mark
inputs.help: yes: mark the control when exactly one is shown and usable, else the nearest step's

inputs.name: why
inputs.help: for the case for a tool: the lesson's sentence saying why the weaver needs it

inputs.name: office
inputs.help: for the case for a tool: the office that would take the message

inputs.name: pane
inputs.help: for the case for a tool: the pane it belongs in

inputs.name: link
inputs.help: the external host's link to the Workshop

requires: the `capture` power: the keymap, the desk and the parts are answered under the row's `capture` doors
zengine-guest-vocabulary booted in this Loom session, declaring the shapes below
tools.example: loom-session run <dir> desk/resolve --name resolve-1 --input shape=BuildRequested --input mark=yes --input words="build this one"
tools.recovery: 'not resolved' names the refused read. A control 'outside this row's read' or the panes named outside its read are the row's doors: ask the weaver. 'a case for a tool' is a draft: file nothing on a weaver's desk before the weaver says yes.
